name: regrade installs a later grading of the same subject; stale regrades, regrades of FINAL and early overrides are refused
notes: c1 (muse, priya@company.com, 'Q3 deck', 14:02; observed 14:02); window [14:00, 14:48]. o1 is the exact sent row (14:02). Gmail passes (acct-a, bound in the grant): e1 synced 14:30 saw [12:00, 14:30] and first saw o1 (observedAt 14:30, the loader default); e2 synced 14:40 saw [12:00, 14:40].

First grading at 14:30 (§3: e2 is later, so ignored): c1 × o1 = tp 1, ce 1, cd 1, subject 1 → 1/1 → rule verified (coverage is partial, not none, so no_coverage does not fire first). §8: VERIFIED is FINAL once an eligible entry has lastSyncAt ≥ end(14:03) + 30 = 14:33; e1 synced 14:30 → PENDING, reasons match.best {o1}.

Event 1, regrade at 14:10 (§8 v1.4: next.computedAt ≥ computedAt): the 14:10 grading (e1 and o1 not yet seen → no_coverage, PENDING) was computed before the stored 14:30 receipt → IllegalTransitionError; nothing changes.
Event 2, regrade at 14:45: e2 (14:40 ≥ 14:33) is now visible → the same VERIFIED, now FINAL, computedAt = finalAt = 14:45. PENDING → FINAL is the one legal regrade.
Event 3, regrade at 15:00: the receipt is FINAL; FINAL receipts are never regraded → IllegalTransitionError.
Event 4, override NOT_FOUND at 14:44: after the first grading (14:30) but before the regraded receipt's computedAt (14:45); §8 v1.4 needs override.at ≥ computedAt → IllegalTransitionError.

Event 5, override NOT_FOUND at 15:05 → USER_OVERRIDDEN, previousState FINAL; the computed VERIFIED stays beside the override; reason override.user {grade: NOT_FOUND} last (§15). inputs: context.priorSpendCents 0 (email.sent is not a spend type).
